THE LETTER — short drama

INT. MAI'S KITCHEN - NIGHT
Characters: MAI, AN
Mai finds a sealed letter beside two cold cups of tea.
Emotion: anxious
Shot size: medium
Continuity: Mai holds the letter in her left hand.
Duration: 12 seconds
MAI
(quietly)
Anh đã hứa sẽ quay lại.

AN: I kept my promise.
Notes: Keep the clock visible behind Mai.

EXT. HOUSE GATE - NIGHT
Characters: MAI, AN
An waits in the rain. Mai opens the gate, still holding the letter.
Emotion: relieved
Shot size: close-up
Continuity: Same sealed letter, still in Mai's left hand.
MAI: Vào nhà đi.
AN: Thank you.
